feature_definition: RATIO_ENTR_TT = ENTR / TT_mean. TT_mean = mean length of qualifying vertical lines (l>=l_min=2, main diagonal excluded) — RQA trapping time notion. ENTR = -sum p(l)*ln(p(l)) over qualifying diagonal-line length distribution (k!=0, main diagonal excluded), p(l)=n(l)/N, natural log. Delay embedding m=2 tau=1 over trailing window W_RR=168, L-inf recurrence with eps=EPS_SCALE*std(window); causal trailing only; fail-closed to NaN/no-signal if TT_mean<=0, no qualifying vertical lines, ENTR<=0/undefined/non-finite, offdiag/recurrence degenerate, or undefined.
